xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnComposition:
Note to the composition of the Board :
1. Tenure has been calculated from the date of appointment as an Independent Director for the first term.
2. Mr. Ashwin Chandran has been re-appointed as an Independent Director for a second term of 5 years from 01-09-2023 to 31-08-2028 and the said re-appointment was approved by the members by means of passing necessary special resolution through postal ballot process on 22-06-2023.
3. Mr. Harsha Varadaraj and Mr. Vijayraghunath were appointed as an Additional Directors by the board under category of Independent with an intention to appoint them as Independent Directors for a first term of 5 years commencing from 20-09-2024 to 19-09-2029, subject to approval of the members. The said appointment of Independent Directors was approved by the members by means of passing necessary resolutions through postal ballot process on 25-10-2024.
4. Mr. Rajkumar Agarwal was appointed as an Additional Director and designated as Executive Director of the Company by the Board for a period of 3 years with effect from 1st July 2025, subject to the approval of the members. The said appointment of Mr. Rajkumar Agarwal as Director and Executive Director were approved by the members by means of passing necessary ordinary resolutions, at their Annual General Meeting held on 10-09-2025.
5. Mrs. Manian Kanikha was appointed as an Additional Director by the Board under the category of Independent with an intention to appoint her as an Independent Director of the Company for a first term of 5 years commencing from 19-09-2025 to 18-09-2030, subject to the approval of the members. The said appointment was approved by the members by means of passing necessary resolution through postal ballot process on 24-10-2025.
